verdict.rationale: Skyfire's own documented capabilities let merchants list approval-gated seller services, accept buyer-agent `pay`/`kya-pay` tokens (including guest checkout), and charge them with guaranteed settlement. Its MCP server lets agents discover sellers and create payment tokens, so purchases can complete inside an agent workflow. The docs never name ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or Copilot, and never describe a native in-chat checkout experience on those surfaces, so delivery there is only implied through generic agent/MCP integration. Missing for 10: documented integrations with named assistant surfaces (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Copilot), an end-to-end in-chat buyer checkout flow, and independent or hands-on corroboration of merchant purchases completing in those surfaces.

support.subject: As a merchant, buyers can complete purchases of my products inside chat and assistant surfaces (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Copilot and peers)

citations.quote: Sellers can use a `kya-pay` token to enable a guest checkout experience for buyer agents.
Your agent is now ready to discover sellers, generate `kya` or `pay` tokens, and instantly execute agentic commerce workflows!
Use this API after delivering a service, tool, or resource to collect payment from a buyer-issued token.
Your organization can act as a unified seller that your own customers' agents transact with.
